page_title: BAR 3-0 OVI | Barcelona v Oviedo 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+2' Great solo effort by Josip Brekalo (Real Oviedo) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
85' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
82' Substitution. Josip Brekalo (Real Oviedo) has come on for Haissem Hassan.
82' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to substitute Santiago Colombatto and he is replaced by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo).
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Federico Vinas walks off the pitch to be replaced by Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo).
81' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lamine Yamal will be replaced by Roony Bardghji (Barcelona).
78' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:9.
75' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Dani Olmo is replaced by Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
75' Barcelona have a goal ruled out for offside!
73' 3 - 0 What a goal that is! Dani Olmo sends a brilliant cross into the box and Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) scores a stunning bicycle kick goal! Wow, take a bow gentlemen. 3:0.
72' Oviedo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
71' The corner from Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is intercepted by Aaron Escandell.
66' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) replacing Lucas Ahijado.
66' Substitution. Alberto Reina walks off the pitch and Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) comes on as a substitute.
62' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
62' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

62' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) gets inside the box and tries to beat Aaron Escandell with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Barcelona win a corner.
61' Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.
60' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Joao Cancelo will be replaced by Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Fermín (Barcelona) coming on for Raphinha.
57' 2 - 0 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) dribbles into the box then perfectly lifts the ball over the goalkeeper and into the net. He couldn't do anything to stop that cheeky lob. 2:0.

55' What a save from Aaron Escandell! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
52' 1 - 0 Fabulous goal. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) collects an exquisite pass and subsequently produces a low shot from the edge of the box which goes in off the left post.
51' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
50' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Oviedo.
50' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
48' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
47' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo).
46' Hansi Flick makes a switch. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is coming on in place of Gerard Martin at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Raphinha (Barcelona) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save.
45+2' PENALTY APPEAL by Oviedo, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

45+2' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Joan Garcia makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) does well to reach an overhit cross into the box from Eric Garcia, but his first-time effort flashes just over the bar.
43' David Costas (Real Oviedo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
42' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Dani Olmo (Barcelona) but poses no threat.
37' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
34' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
33' Aaron Escandell (Real Oviedo) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
31' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:3.
29' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
26' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.
26' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
26' Marc Casado (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Now Barcelona have a corner.
25' Raphinha (Barcelona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

24' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Joan Garcia thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
23' 1:3 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
19' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aaron Escandell intercepts the ball.
18' Flag up against Joao Cancelo (Barcelona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
17' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) commits a foul and Juan Martinez immediately signals a free kick.
15' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on. Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
14' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
14' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' The game is interrupted. Gerard Martin (Barcelona) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
9' Oviedo are ruled offside.
6' The ball possession is 80:20.
3' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
2' Barcelona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half has started.
Oviedo will kick-off.
Juan Martinez will referee today's match.
